veranderings.rede: 'Vergaan' already means to waste away; 'weg' after it is redundant and unidiomatic.

veranderings.voor: Die modder en sand daar rondom
veranderings.na: Die modder en sand rondom dit
veranderings.rede: 'Daar rondom' is loose; 'rondom dit' is the natural, clear form at this grade.

veranderings.blok: Wat moet gebeur, en wat die kans beter maak
veranderings.voor: Wat moet gebeur, en wat die kans beter maak
veranderings.na: Wat moet gebeur en wat die kans beter maak
veranderings.rede: AWS: no comma before 'en' between two parts of one phrase that are not separate sentences (heading; apply only if headings are editable).

veranderings.voor: sedimentêre gesteente en daar is 'n goeie rede daarvoor
veranderings.na: sedimentêre gesteente, en daar is 'n goeie rede daarvoor
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences each with its own subject and verb; the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.voor: drie gesteentes wat uit sulke lae kom
veranderings.na: drie gesteentes wat in lae vorm
veranderings.rede: 'Uit sulke lae kom' is wooden and vague; the previous sentence already says these rocks form in layers.

veranderings.voor: Presies daardie modder en sand is wat die plant of dier toegemaak het
veranderings.na: Dit was juis daardie modder en sand wat die plant of dier toegemaak het
veranderings.rede: Calque of 'precisely that ... is what'; the Afrikaans cleft 'Dit was juis ... wat' is natural and the past tense matches the event.

veranderings.voor: Die laag word later hard en die fossiel sit vas daarin
veranderings.na: Die laag word later hard, en die fossiel sit daarin vas
veranderings.rede: Separable verb 'vassit' puts 'vas' at the end; AWS comma before 'en' joining two full sentences.

veranderings.voor: uit die kalk uit die doppe en harde dele van seediere
veranderings.na: uit die kalk van seediere se doppe en harde dele
veranderings.rede: Avoids the clumsy double 'uit ... uit' without changing the meaning.
'Vind' is the usual word for finding fossils; 'kry' is colloquial here.

veranderings.blok: Wat die lae vir ons sê
veranderings.rede: 'Dieper onder' is not idiomatic; 'laer af' is the natural way to say lower down in the layers.

veranderings.voor: Die rotse hou tog 'n rekord van daardie lewe vir ons
veranderings.na: Tog bewaar die rotse vir ons 'n rekord van daardie lewe
veranderings.rede: 'Hou 'n rekord ... vir ons' is a calque of 'keep a record for us'; 'bewaar' with 'vir ons' before the object reads naturally.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences each with its own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: 'n deel van die plant of dier se lyf
veranderings.na: 'n deel van 'n plant of dier se lyf
veranderings.rede: 'Die plant of dier' refers back to nothing in this block; 'n' is correct and matches the glossary definition.

vlae.teks: 'n Fossiel van 'n teken wat 'n plant of dier agtergelaat het, is 'n spoorfossiel.
vlae.rede: The study-text sentence lacks the closing phrase 'nie van 'n deel van sy lyf nie' that the glossary definition carries and that the protected entry says keeps leaf imprints and root casts with body fossils. Adding it is content, so it is not proposed; a person or the writer should decide whether this sentence should match the decided definition.

vlae.teks: Sandsteen en kalksteen is twee rotse waarin mense fossiele kry.
vlae.rede: The block names three rocks (leiklip, sandsteen, kalksteen) but this closing sentence names only two, which may read as if leiklip carries no fossils. Not changed because it is a content choice.
